name: @pipeworx/mcp-meteostat

tools.name: find_stations
tools.description: Find Meteostat weather station IDs by place name and/or geographic proximity — the lookup you need BEFORE get_daily_history / get_monthly_normals (which require a station_id). Search by name ("San Francisco", "Heathrow"), filter by country (ISO-2 like "US", "GB"), and/or rank by nearest to a lat/lon. Returns each station's id, name, country, region, coordinates, elevation, timezone, and data inventory (which granularities — hourly/daily/monthly — are available and their date ranges, so you can pick a station that actually has the period you need). Use for "weather station near X", "what is the station ID for Y", "stations in country Z".

near_lat.description: Latitude to rank stations by proximity (pair with near_lon).

near_lon.description: Longitude to rank stations by proximity (pair with near_lat).

tools.name: get_daily_history
tools.description: Daily historical weather for a Meteostat station between two dates. Returns date-keyed temperature (avg/min/max), precipitation, snow, wind, pressure, sun hours. Get a station_id from find_stations.

tools.name: get_monthly_normals
tools.description: Monthly climate normals for a station — long-run averages of temperature, precipitation, and pressure by calendar month. Useful for "what's normal in May here" baselines.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-meteostat forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the meteostat pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
